categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches 'Tests' label and modifies unit test suite in 'src/test/fs_tests.cpp'.
categories.rationale: Adds a unit test in fs_tests to detect an upstream libstdc++ toolchain bug on Windows. The PR description notes that BerkeleyRODatabase::Backup() in src/wallet/migrate.cpp relies on fs::copy_file overwriting existing files, which fails under GCC 12.x to 14.2 cross-compilation with a 'File exists' error.
